_instructions: Copy this file to clients/<client-name>.json, fill in the answers under "profile" (leave anything you don't know blank), then run scripts/setup-client.ts. The questions are below for reference.
locationId: PASTE the GHL location id (from the GHL web address: /v2/location/<this>/...)

questions.AI Business Name: Business name, exactly as customers should see it
questions.AI Trade: Trade, e.g. plumber, electrician, painter, carpenter
questions.AI Outside Area: What to do with leads outside your area
questions.AI After Hours: After-hours / emergency work and any extra charge; what to tell people who ask for a call outside hours
questions.AI Pricing: Call-out fee or pricing the bot MAY mention (leave blank to never mention prices)
questions.AI Job Length: How long a typical visit/quote takes, and notice needed
questions.AI Qualifying Questions: What you need to know about a job before going out (e.g. photos, owner or renter, access, budget)
questions.AI Emergencies: What counts as an emergency for you, and how to handle it
questions.AI Tone: Tone: casual or formal; words to use or avoid
questions.AI Extra Info: Licence number, guarantees, payment methods, common questions and answers
questions.AI Options: Offer: both (callback or booking), callback, or booking
questions.AI Calendar ID: GHL calendar ID for bookings (filled in during setup)
